div.head: III Eg 2.2
div.ab: ⁊ æt nanum botwyrðum gylte ne forwyrce man mare þane his wer.
⁊ æt nannum botwyrðum gylte ne forwyrce mon mare þonne his wer.
⁊ æt nanum botwyrðum gilte ne forwyrce man mare þonne his wer.
Et de nulla emendabili re forisfaciat homo plus quam weram suam.
⁊ æt nanum botwyrðum gilte ne forwyrce man mare þonne his wer.
And æt nanum botwyrðum gylte ne forwyrce man mare þane his wer.
Und bei keiner [durch Geld] büssbaren Schuld verwirke jemand mehr als sein eigenes Wergeld.
And for no offence that can be compensated [with money] let anyone forfeit more than his own wergild.
And no man shall forfeit more than his wergeld for any offence for which compensation may be paid.
In crimes that admit of compensation, no one is to forfeit more than his wergild.
And no one is to be fined more than his wergild for any offense for which compensation can be paid.

Cf. Gl Strafgeldfixum 1a; busslos 1; Wergeld 26ff. The fine is limited only for each single offence; Schreuer Verbrechenskonk. rightly rejects the view that a limitation on the cumulation of compensations is intended
Ersatz und Busse für den Kläger besteht neben dem Straf-Wergeld für den Gerichtsherrn; I Atr 1, 5
Restitution and compensation for the plaintiff exist alongside the penal wergild for the lord of the court; I Atr 1, 5
As opposed to crimes which are botleas, i.e. for which no compensation can be paid; cf. III Atr. 1.
